data.content_ref: inline:Repair the determinism failure SRC_008 exposes: make DefenseWitness construction canonical by fixing a total order over accepted defenders derived deterministically from the artifact graph (e.g., lexicographic on stable node identifiers) and running the greedy scan in that order, so the emitted witness is unique; alternatively emit the full accepted-defender set as the canonical witness to eliminate order dependence entirely, preserving polynomial cost since that set is already computed by the fixpoint.
